description: This file defines device management utilities for PyTorch, including context managers and functions for handling device contexts and constructors.

classes.name: DeviceContext
classes.description: A context manager class for temporarily setting the current device in PyTorch.

methods.name: _device_constructors
methods.description: Returns a cached set of torch functions that are considered device constructors.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DeviceContext with a specific device.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enters the device context, setting the current device.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Exits the device context, restoring the previous device and mode stack.

methods.name: __torch_function__
methods.description: Overrides torch functions to automatically set the device if applicable.
